get_affirmation.description: Get one short, encouraging affirmation picked at random, such as 'Small progress is still progress'. Handy for a daily pep-talk message in Slack or email, or for a friendly line in a standup reminder. No API key required.
get_affirmation.name: get_affirmation

affirmation.description: One short, encouraging sentence, e.g. 'You are a capable human'.

word_count.description: How many words the affirmation has.

description: Get a random, encouraging affirmation from affirmations.dev, a tiny open-source API for fighting impostor syndrome. Drop a pep talk into a daily message, a standup reminder or a team channel. No account or API key required.
